title: Premium carry with inverse-volatility weights inside each leg (v8.2 and bf2)
rule: premium carry unchanged (7-day mean premium index, long the lowest third / short the highest third, weekly rebalance) except that inside each leg weights are proportional to 1 / 30-day daily vol of each coin (known at the decision), each leg summing to 1 as before
pass: replaces the premium-carry sleeve; strict rule vs v8.2 (2.636 / 1.203 / 3.764 / 2.357) and, separately, vs bf2 at measured costs (2.427 / 3.751 / 2.169)
